targets.note: Tasks, Mine: While you were away on top; Needs you holds a review handed to Irfad, work sent back by Omar's private agent (named Omar Reyes (Agent)), a team task with Take and a question; then Now, Next and Waiting on others, where a team task shows Taken by Sara Khan.
The task page of the review handed to Irfad: the baton path by name, Approve and Send back, a way back to Tasks.
A team task nobody took: Take it, and the rail's Taken by line.
The review's status menu: only the moves Irfad's seat allows, in their words.
The review in the right pane, as it opens beside the chat it was pressed in: no rail, Open the full page.
The Board by status: one column each, a card per task.
The Board after a keyboard walk: arrows moved focus from the first card to the card in the next column; one card takes Tab.
Space on the focused card opens the status menu, with the moves this seat allows.
The Timeline: a line per dated task.
The Timeline after a keyboard walk: ArrowDown moved focus to the second row.
A task given to a guest: the menu says the guest will see the task, its thread and its files, and offers Give it or Cancel.
